name: An Experience in StuffLand
source:
You're a visitor to a special land called StuffLand, and your guide will help you navigate around the area. You'll be able to meet all the people there, and you may be lucky enough to meet the queen! Enjoy the game and its craziness as much as you can.

[From [url=http://renai.us/game/stuffland.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
你是一个名为StuffLand的特殊土地的游客，你的导游将帮助你游览该地区。你将能够见到那里的所有人，说不定你还能幸运地见到女王呢！尽可能地享受游戏及其疯狂。

[来自[url=http://renai.us/game/stuffland.shtml]仁爱档案馆[/url]]
